dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body point towards the posterior terminus, forming a smooth conical profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency lighter grey patches observed primarily on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the slate-grey baseline and lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast white linear rake marks oriented longitudinally on the posterior dorsal plane; several small circular white punctate marks near the caudal taper.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least four parallel white rake marks centrally located on the lower back; multiple small circular depigmented spots near the tail junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The rake marks exhibit sharp contrast against the dark-grey primary skin tone.
